historical_r05.interpretation: R05 remains diagnostic evidence under its original contract; this successor contract cannot turn an R05 unavailable or failed gate into a pass

d3part_keyword.solver_compatibility_basis: LS-DYNA R15.0.2 accepted five fields at runtime in Job 72252362; the R05 tail fields produced Warning 10457 and are not carried forward

interval_rule.left_hand_side: each actual adjacent D3PART state interval
interval_rule.right_hand_side: nominal output interval plus the maximum positive GLSTAT explicit solver time_step whose solver state lies in the same D3PART interval, plus time-word tolerance

timeline.start_rule: the first D3PART time must be zero within the frozen time-word tolerance
timeline.solver_evidence_coverage_rule: finite strictly increasing GLSTAT times with positive finite time_step values must cover every D3PART interval
timeline.termination_coverage_rule: last D3PART time plus nominal output interval plus final positive explicit solver time_step plus time-word tolerance must reach termination_time_ms
timeline.claim_boundary: solver-realizable scheduling is a numerical output-completeness rule, not permission to fit a percentage tolerance to observed R05 states

crossing_resolution.resolved_alive_to_alive_rule: directional centroid travel across the capture plane must be positive and no greater than 0.5 times that case mesh
crossing_resolution.availability_policy: temporal ambiguity remains subject to the frozen mass-fraction gate; unavailable is never replaced with zero

return_evidence.completeness_semantics: returned-evidence completeness only; no solver-response, numerical-convergence, physical-validity, P0, or P1 admission follows from equivalence

d3hsp.command_binding: scheduler stdout must bind the exact LS-DYNA o= output path
d3hsp.identity_policy: the solver_o_output must be included in the hash-bound run artifact manifest

binout_logical_database_equivalences.identity_policy: the binout family must be included in the hash-bound run artifact manifest

admission.physical_validity: requires independent experimental evidence and cannot be established by this contract

claim_boundary: This file freezes a future real-output interface; it is not an R06 deck or solver submission.
The contract records lessons from R05 without rewriting the R05 design, deck, return, static validation, or admission result.
Passing serialization, timeline, PID, and return-equivalence checks would establish engineering consistency only.
